name: Winnipeg Big & Blind 2024
information:
# This competition has no 3x3 and is not recommended for newcomers.

We are working hard on announcing a typical competition experience in Manitoba as soon as possible. Stay tuned!

This competition is in conjuction with [FMC Canada 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCCanada2024), a multi-location, synchronous FMC competition across Canada. Winnipeg will take part from 11am-3:30pm. Check out [FMC Canada 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCCanada2024) for more info!
